title: Subjectivity Intersection Mathematics: A Common Pointed-Braid Source for Quantum History and Lorentzian Geometry
description: This working preprint constructs a single typed mathematical system in which a quantum history and an initial Lorentzian geometry are read from one fixed finite pointed-braid source and subsequently evolved in one coupled local system with relational backreaction. The construction combines exact finite algebraic certificates with explicit bridge assumptions. Its main theorem is conditional, fixed-finite, local to one regular patch, and valid on a nonzero short-time interval. It is not peer reviewed and does not establish an empirically validated theory of quantum gravity, absolute semiclassical gravity, or an ontological theory of subjectivity.
